'''Origin:''' Centaur
'''Age:''' 17

Like many races in the world, the leonine centaurs of [[Elona]] are struggling to survive. They've overcome incredible hardships, including the need to survive without help from more populous races—including, it would seem, humanity. '''Zhed''' is a centaur who's keenly aware of this last fact. He's seen his people suffer and die while the masses of humanity continue to spread across the savannah. In fact, he claims to have seen atrocities the Kournans would not dare admit. Some centaurs insist that [[human]]s are responsible for the death of their race, and Zhed certainly agrees. At best, he sees the "two-legs" as a means to an end. In the worst of times, he sees them as rivals... or prey. His dealings with humans have not been good, but if he must work with adventurers to reach his goals — and adventurers need to work with him — he'll need to set aside his animosity. Rise up and crush your enemy!"'' :''"Whoever taught you to fight wasted his time."'' :''"You have made your last error."'' :''"You will be fodder for jackals!"'' ==Notes== *A duplicate Zhed will show up as a "Centaur Elementalist". *Zhed's default weapon is a customized blue [[Water Staff]] (core skin) with Energy +10, 11-20 Cold damage, an attribute requirement of 7 Water Magic and 20% HCT Water Magic. *Since he is the only centaur hero, Zhed cannot transfer [[disease]] to or from other [[party]] members but can receive disease from other centaur. *Zhed has a [[miniature]] [[Miniature Zhed Shadowhoof|version]]. *As with all heroes, this one has a [[Everlasting Zhed Shadowhoof Tonic|tonic form]]. == Trivia == * Zhed was called Zhed Shadowpaw during beta and [[Korsu]] still uses that name in his dialogue. * Like most non-human [[henchmen]], he does not use [[emote]]s. * The voice acting for this NPC is [[Robin Atkin Downes]], who also voices [[Prince Rurik]], [[Goren]], and [[Prince Bokka the Magnificent]]. {{Heroes nav}}
